aggressive_definition: No aggressive prostate cancer endpoint was defined.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The analytic cohort consisted of 2440 men 50 years of age or older who were followed for a median of 10 years.
reason: The prospective cohort analyzed subsequent development and incidence of prostate cancer overall. No aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, or lethal endpoint was reported.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Adjusted for age and race, men in the lowest quartile had a relative risk of 2.2 (95% confidence intervals, 1.1, 4.3) compared to those in the highest quartile.
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate is for overall incident prostate cancer. The supplied row stores the reciprocal of the abstract's lowest-versus-highest comparison, but its endpoint remains general prostate cancer.
